abstract: In short, the comparison of the arms gives these main findings. Overall, Brostamide and Alvenor reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Brostamide increases side effects compared with Alvenor.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Brostamide and Alvenor reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Brostamide increases side effects compared with Alvenor.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. All data for this comparison were collected at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 4. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Side effects | 160 | 650 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Side effects | 237 | 650 |
